publisher: MassGIS (Massachusetts Property Tax Parcels, Level 3 assessor data) for the City of Pittsfield
notes: Fallback: no district layer found for Pittsfield. This is a PARCEL layer; each parcel carries its assessor zoning code in ZONING (e.g. R12, IL), not district polygons. Pittsfield zoning districts are not published as a queryable service (the city links only a PDF map and GIS Parcel Viewer). Source is MassGIS statewide parcels filtered to TOWN_ID 236 (Pittsfield). Dissolving parcels by ZONING would give districts.
